title: CmdPal: Dedicated flyout - exception when showing details pane

comment.body: Thanks for the stack trace: it already pinpoints UIElement.get_Visibility while DockPageControl.ShowDetails is called from SetSelectedItem. The HRESULT is 0x8001010E, but the trace alone does not show whether this happens for every app result or only during a particular navigation/details-pane transition. Please provide: 1) the exact PowerToys build or commit; 2) whether selecting any Search apps result reproduces it or only a specific entry; and 3) whether it coincides with navigation or the details pane opening/closing. The existing trace is useful, so no generic log or ZIP request is needed.
